title: FJ62 with 1HDT wirings and gauges
ai_summary: Owner of a 1986 FJ62 inherited a partially completed 1HD-T diesel swap and was finishing the wiring/instrumentation, since the diesel's VR (variable reluctance) tach signal is incompatible with the stock gas tachometer. Other members pointed to a Shift Kits Australia signal converter and a Dakota Digital Hall-effect sensor as working solutions used on similar 1HZ/1HD-T swaps.

complications.detail: 1HD-T's VR sine-wave tach signal incompatible with stock gas tachometer, requiring a signal converter
Brake fluid and clutch reservoir warning sensors left unconnected after the swap
